name: Square
tagline: Square gives small businesses, including coffee shops, bars, and retail counters, a point-of-sale system along with payments, payroll, and inventory tools in one dashboard. Its built-in AI assistant surfaces sales trends, flags slow-moving inventory, and answers plain-language questions about how the business is doing without needing a dedicated analyst. Millions of small merchants run their counter operations on Square.
